Class StaticCDRepository

java.lang.Object
lms.persistence.StaticCDRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
CDRepository
public class StaticCDRepository extends Object implements CDRepository
In-memory implementation of CDRepository using a static HashMap.

Stores CDs in a map with support for CRUD operations and search by title or artist. Pre-loaded with sample data. This implementation is not thread-safe and intended for testing purposes.

Version:
2.0
Author:
Ahmad Salameh
